subject: MedWorks - initiating SIG and clarifying dataflow & hosting details
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mark Thompson <mark.thompson@medworks.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@medworks.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MedWorks - SIG initiation + quick recap from today's discovery

Hi Mark / Aisha,

Thanks again for taking the time today — useful conversation. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so the SIG (or CAIQ/custom) path can get started: 

- Status check: you mentioned MedWorks is targeting SOC 2 Type II in Q3 2027; is there an in-flight audit firm already engaged? Please confirm.
- Data residency: you need EU-resident model hosting for a subset of PHI (HIPAA scope). We should confirm the exact customer datasets that will be considered PHI and whether those are processed in-host or sent to Redwood as plaintext.
- Hosting boundary: you prefer Private (VPC) deployment for production workloads and Hosted for sandbox/testing. Can you confirm minimum network access (e.g., VPN vs. private peering)?
- Auth/SAML: SSO + SCIM expected; you flagged an IdP-friendly SAML flow. Please share SAML metadata or a working endpoint.
- Evidence & timeline: we'll prefill the SIG workbook — could you assign a primary technical contact for evidence collection?

Next steps I propose:
1) We attach a prefiller workbook (blank) — please add owners & high-level answers where you have them.
2) Jordan (cc'd) will propose an evidence intake template and a lightweight network diagram request.
3) Grace (cc'd) will confirm Redwood's SOC 2 artifact ETA for prefilled questions (we have SOC 2 in scope via audits and can share summary artifacts).
4) Let's block 30 minutes next week to kick off the SIG intake if you can (I included two time proposals below).

Attachments: medworks_sig_prefill.xlsx (blank prefiller), network_diagram_v1.png (example ask), sso-config-snippet.txt (SAML attribute expectations).

Availability proposals:
- Tue 09 Mar 10:00-10:30 PT
- Wed 10 Mar 14:00-14:30 PT

Thanks — I want to make this as low-friction as possible.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: Mark Thompson <mark.thompson@medworks.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedWorks - SIG initiation + quick recap from today's discovery

Kimberly — thanks for the detailed recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Audit: yes, we engaged Linden & Co for SOC 2; kickoff is penciled for 2027-07-01. We can share the engagement letter.
- PHI/dataflow: the PHI set includes patient identifiers and images. For now the plan is to process images in our environment and send derived text (transcriptions/labels) to Redwood. We need to confirm whether derived text is still considered PHI under your handling model.
- Hosting: Private VPC is preferred for production, yes. For VPN vs. peering — our infra team prefers private peering (AWS Direct Connect) if you support it.
- SSO: I'll have our IdP team send SAML metadata; provisional contact is aisha.khan@medworks.com.

One more ask — can Redwood share a short writeup of how KV cache / prefix caching is handled across tenancy boundaries? Our security folks asked about potential cross-tenant leakage for partially cached sequences.

We can do Wed 10 Mar at 14:00 PT.

-Mark
Mark Thompson
Head of Security, MedWorks Health
mark.thompson@medworks.com

Thanks, Kim — Wed 10 Mar 14:00 PT works. I'll have our IdP send SAML metadata to kimberly_park@redwood.com before the call.

On the KV/cache question: our security lead asked specifically for a design note rather than high-level language — can you have Grace include the cache segmentation model (per-tenant keying, eviction boundaries) and whether any derived tokens are persisted to disk? Also, our infra contact will upload a brief network diagram to the Drive link you provided; expect it later today.

Finally, to speed the SIG, would Redwood accept partial prefill now and follow with evidence bundles (we'll do that but want to confirm it's OK)?
